notes: REF-BM-10: tag inputs are plain comma-separated text fields; no datalist/autocomplete/suggestion of existing tags anywhere in the web app. REF-BM-21: bulk actions run on explicitly selected ids and the only affordance is 'Select all visible' which selects just the current page (pageSize 60); with pagination there is no way to apply a bulk action to the whole filtered collection >60 items, and the bulk API accepts only id lists, not a filter. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive / Wayback / archive.org support anywhere in code; only local HTML/PDF snapshots. REF-BM-29: saved_views store name+query+included tag_ids only; there is no structured excluded-tags facet (exclusion only achievable via free-text NOT/-#tag in the query). REF-BM-30: import parses url/title/folder-tags but never reads ADD_DATE; store.create stamps created_at with now(), so 'date added' is not preserved. REF-BM-32: preferences cover default sort and font size (text_size) plus sort direction, but there is no 'displayed items' setting (page size hardcoded to 60).
